name: SM_Snake_Pillar_PR

textures.channels: tangent normal, OpenGL (green up; flip green on import)
R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic

material_exception: unique BC/N/ORM bake private to this asset (not a row of ART_STANDARD.md section 2): the task for the unclaimed families asks for a baked set per asset, and the surface detail here (see dresses) does not exist in the shared library
pivot: base centre (bbox centre in X/Y, mesh bottom at z = 0), front on -Y
dresses: sandstone column, 2.5 m, fluted drums on a moulded base, a green snake wound four times round the shaft with its head lifted
status: source delivered; not imported into Unreal, not bound in families.json
known_weaknesses: The snake is a smooth tapering sweep with a wedge head: no eyes, mouth or belly scutes, and it floats a few millimetres off the shaft in places instead of pressing into it. Scripted pillars in the game animate the snake; this is the still frame. Stone is one tinted rock scan with procedural moss and lichen; carving detail comes from displacement, not from modelled tool work.
